blocks.text: The module documentation describes the dotenv source and the four required configuration concerns: pairing, root, backend websocket, and workspace identity.
blocks.title: Daemon configuration contract

blocks.text: ConfigError is the startup-validation exception. DaemonConfig stores the pairing token, safe root, backend URL, workspace id, and optional preview settings.
blocks.title: Immutable config shape

blocks.anchor: def load_config(env_path: Path | None = None) -> DaemonConfig:
blocks.text: load_config selects the adjacent or supplied env file, loads it, validates token and root presence, and requires a websocket URL and workspace id.
blocks.title: Required values

blocks.text: The backend URL must use ws or wss, the root passes assert_safe_root, and an opt-in preview target is validated through build_preview_config.
blocks.title: URL, root, and preview validation

blocks.text: generate_pairing_token creates a URL-safe random token; the module CLI prints it only when invoked with --generate-token.
blocks.title: Setup helper

gotchas: The loader uses override=True when loading dotenv values.
Preview settings are validated only when a preview target is set.
Environment values and token contents are not included in this note.
how_it_works: Checks token strength and required fields
purpose: The daemon config loader reads its adjacent dotenv file, validates required startup values, checks the allowed root with path_guard, and optionally builds a preview proxy configuration. It returns an immutable DaemonConfig or raises ConfigError before the daemon starts.
summary: Loads and validates daemon pairing, workspace, backend websocket, root, and optional preview settings.

symbols.summary: Immutable validated configuration passed to the daemon runtime.
Loads dotenv settings and rejects unsafe or incomplete daemon startup configuration.

unknowns: The daemon connection and preview proxy consumers are outside this file.
